# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 1,707 AI agent tools in 30 categories, including 239 MCP servers. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Catalog last checked: 2026-10-23 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the read-only JSON feeds under /api/
- [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json): same OpenAPI 3.1 description at the well-known address
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Key pages

- [MCP server pricing table](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/pricing.html): every MCP server's stated pricing, dated, with change history
- [MCP server link status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/link-status.html): latest automated link check for every MCP server, with change history
- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://agentscout-mcp.agentscouthq.workers.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories and best_for_task. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance
- [MCP servers category](https://agentscouthq.com/categories/mcp-servers.html): 239 tools
- [New tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-10-22 to 2026-10-23): 55

- [DIRI AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/diri-ai.html) (added 2026-10-23): DIRI AI is a voice role-play trainer for salespeople. You pick a situation, such as a price objection, an intro meeting, a cold call or a client who wants to leave, set the difficulty, and talk out loud with an AI customer that reacts to what you actually say rather than a fixed script. After each call you get an instant report with a transcript, the key moments highlighted and specific stronger wording to try next time, plus a history of your practice. Managers can use it to help new hires ramp up before real calls.
- [Crolytics](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/crolytics.html) (added 2026-10-23): Crolytics is a managed, governed AI workspace for B2B marketing and go-to-market teams, hosted on Google Cloud. Its agents connect to your CMS, GA4, Search Console and knowledge base through custom MCP connectors, answer analytics questions in plain language, track how AI assistants cite your brand (GEO/AEO), and draft or update website pages behind human approval gates, with per-person permissions and a tamper-evident audit log. Teams use it from the Crolytics chat or inside their own Claude or ChatGPT account.
- [Vellm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vellm.html) (added 2026-10-23): Vellm turns photos of people and pets into short AI videos from ready-made templates. Pick one of 108 dance, funny, duo and pet templates built on ByteDance Seedance 2.5, upload your photos and it renders your own version, or start from a prompt in its Create Studio. A remote MCP server (https://api.vellm.app/mcp, OAuth sign-in) lets MCP-compatible AI apps create videos from your Vellm account.
- [SalesTouch](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/salestouch.html) (added 2026-10-23): SalesTouch is a LinkedIn MCP server for AI agents. Connect Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or any remote MCP client to https://www.salestouch.io/api/mcp and your agent can find prospects, research people and companies, send invitations and messages, and handle follow-ups through 45 purpose-built LinkedIn tools instead of browser automation. Scoped OAuth, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, working hours and a human-paced action queue keep the account under control.
- [Vidmoat](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vidmoat.html) (added 2026-10-23): Vidmoat is a hosted AI video editor you direct in chat. Describe the edit and its agent cuts dead air, adds word-synced captions, grades and reframes your footage on a real timeline, where you can review and change any cut by hand before rendering an MP4. It works in the browser, on Telegram (@vidmoat_bot) and over MCP (https://api.vidmoat.com/api/mcp, OAuth), so Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can drive edits too.
- [only-cli](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/only-cli.html) (added 2026-10-23): only-cli (oc) turns any website into a compact command-line view for AI agents. It distills a page into short text with numbered actions that agents like Claude Code can follow and click through, so agents browse the web using a small fraction of the tokens raw HTML or screenshots would take.
- [CutBay](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cutbay.html) (added 2026-10-23): CutBay is a chat-based AI video agent that turns ideas, web links, documents, slides, spreadsheets and your own media into finished videos. You describe what you want and it drafts explainers, product demos, slideshows, animated charts, talking-head clips or YouTube Shorts, then lets you keep editing by chat, with add-ons such as B-roll and automatic subtitles.
- [Agente Smart Documents](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agente-smart-documents.html) (added 2026-10-23): Agente Smart Documents turns a finished Word document into a reusable template your AI agent can fill. You upload an example, it builds the template, then ChatGPT or Codex, Claude, Grok Bot, Hermes or the web workspace asks only for the details that are missing and hands back a filled .docx with the original layout kept, for you to review before sending. A few documents are free each month, then a flat monthly fee per office.
- [Streamkap MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/streamkap-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-23): Streamkap's official CLI and MCP server let AI agents manage real-time change-data-capture pipelines on Streamkap. An agent can create and edit sources, destinations, pipelines and transforms, check their status and troubleshoot lag, streaming database changes into warehouses and apps without clicking through the console.
- [mu](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mu.html) (added 2026-10-23): mu is an open-source coding agent with a judgment kernel: a small, fast judge model makes the many routine decisions in each turn so the main model only gets the context it needs. It ships as a command-line tool and a desktop app and aims to keep coding sessions focused and cheap.
- [agent-manager](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-manager.html) (added 2026-10-23): agent-manager is a terminal app built on tmux for running many AI coding agents at once. It shows live status for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Grok, Cursor and other sessions in a foldable project tree, adds a quick prompt bar, and has a diff reviewer whose line comments are sent straight back to the right agent, on macOS, Linux and Windows.
- [0.security](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/0-security.html) (added 2026-10-23): 0 is an open, self-improving AI operating system for offensive security work. Its agents investigate code and binaries for vulnerabilities, test defenses, verify findings with working proofs and help fix the issues, and the team behind it publishes the advisories it has found in real open-source projects.
- [nanocode](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nanocode.html) (added 2026-10-23): nanocode is a small SDK for embedding frontier-model agents inside your own apps and tools. It provides the agent loop, tool calling and session handling for models such as Claude and GPT in a compact codebase, so developers can ship a capable embedded agent without adopting a heavy framework.
- [TapQ](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tapq.html) (added 2026-10-23): TapQ is an always-on voice layer for the coding and work agents you already run. You talk to Claude Code, Codex and others through your earbuds, interrupt them, steer the work and hear spoken updates, so you can supervise agents hands-free while away from the keyboard.
- [Rome OS](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rome-os.html) (added 2026-10-23): Rome is an open-source agent OS for recursive agents that compounds what they learn. Agents build their own tools, keep context and reuse capabilities across tasks instead of starting fresh each time, so a long-running assistant grows more capable the more it works.
- [Paritok](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/paritok.html) (added 2026-10-23): Paritok is a compression gateway that sits between a coding agent and its LLM. Using its own open-source 4B code-aware model, it shrinks tool output, files and conversation history on the fly without losing what the agent needs, which cuts token bills and lets agent sessions run longer before they hit context limits.
- [Waku](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/waku.html) (added 2026-10-23): Waku is a native desktop app that gathers your local coding agents in one place. It shows sessions from Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok and Pi on a single timeline that stays entirely on your machine, so you can follow and switch between agent runs without juggling terminals.
- [Jev](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/jev.html) (added 2026-10-23): Jev is an open-source chat assistant for Android, Windows and macOS that reads the conversation on your screen, judges what the other person wants and whether a message looks risky, and drafts candidate replies for you. It fills in the reply box, but you always decide whether to send, so it helps with tricky messages without acting on its own.
- [Edgegap MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/edgegap-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-23): Edgegap's official MCP server lets AI coding agents deploy and run multiplayer game servers on Edgegap's edge hosting network. From the editor, an agent can push server builds, start and stop deployments, check matchmaking and fleet status and read logs, so game developers can manage their online backend in plain language.
- [SuprSend MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/suprsend-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-23): SuprSend's official hosted MCP server gives AI agents and coding assistants access to a SuprSend notification workspace. An agent can look up and manage users and lists, inspect and edit notification workflows and templates, and read delivery data across email, SMS, push, Slack and in-app inbox channels without leaving the chat or editor.
- [Speakeasy Gram](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/speakeasy-gram.html) (added 2026-10-23): Gram is Speakeasy's open-source platform for building, hosting and governing MCP servers. Teams can turn APIs into curated MCP toolsets, host them, and manage which agents and people may use which servers from one control plane, with sign-in, access policies and usage visibility; its own MCP server lets an agent manage that setup directly.
- [Keboola MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/keboola-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-23): Keboola's official MCP server lets AI assistants and coding agents work with a Keboola data project: browse storage tables and buckets, read and write SQL transformations, run and debug jobs and components, and build data flows from a chat. It can run locally or as Keboola's hosted remote server, with access scoped to the project token or OAuth sign-in you grant.
- [Tulimoa Memory](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tulimoa-memory.html) (added 2026-10-23): Tulimoa Memory is a hosted, shared memory store for AI agents and agent swarms. Agents write what they learn into it during the day; overnight a separate model sorts those notes into a knowledge graph with associative recall, and each agent starts the morning with a short briefing so it reads less and knows more. It is billed per call, with starting credit to try it.
- [Userpilot Agent Analytics](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/userpilot-agent-analytics.html) (added 2026-10-23): Userpilot Agent Analytics shows product teams how users actually get on with the AI agent inside their app. It reads the agent's conversations at scale and reports whether people got what they needed or left frustrated, so teams can see where the agent fails, which requests it can't handle and how agent use ties back to product engagement, alongside Userpilot's existing product analytics.
- [Financial Cents MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/financial-cents-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-23): The Financial Cents MCP server connects an accounting, bookkeeping or tax firm's Financial Cents practice-management account to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other MCP clients. Staff can ask about overdue work, unpaid invoices or missing client tax documents in plain English and have the assistant log time or create tasks, with each connection bound to one firm, your own permissions applied, writes confirmed in the client and deletes not offered at all. It is a hosted server signed in with OAuth and comes with the Scale plan.
- [System One API](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/system-one-api.html) (added 2026-10-23): System One API is the hosted decision API behind TypeSafe Jev, with an open-source TypeScript SDK for AI agents. Where the TypeSafe Jev listing covers the decision model itself, this listing covers the developer API and console: send text or app context and get back a typed choice, a score or a yes/no probability for routing tools, ranking results and checking conditions, with API keys, call logs and credit use managed in one place.
- [HireDov](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/hiredov.html) (added 2026-10-23): HireDov is an AI sourcing agent. Describe what you need to buy and its agent, Dov, finds qualified suppliers, sends each a tailored request for quote in their own language, chases every reply and brings the quotes back to one dashboard to compare; first quotes usually arrive within a few days. You see the suppliers it finds before you pay.
- [PeekPanda](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/peekpanda.html) (added 2026-10-23): PeekPanda is competitor research for iOS apps. Open any app to see the Meta ads it keeps paying for and how long each has run, the US App Store searches it ranks for, and which of its posts went viral. Use it in the web app, or add its MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can answer questions about any iOS competitor.
- [HaveTML](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/havetml.html) (added 2026-10-22): HaveTML lets AI agents publish what they make as a permanent share link. Ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to publish HTML, Markdown, JSON or YAML, and you get a sandboxed link anyone can open without logging in. Each link keeps its version history, supports comments, and can be set to private, unlisted or public.
- [Teebots](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/teebots.html) (added 2026-10-22): Teebots is a free desktop app that keeps a small team of AI bots on your own computer. Each bot can use a different model through your own API key, with requests going straight to the provider, and keeps its own private memory alongside a shared group memory. Put several bots in one group chat and @mention one to hand it a task, or let them pass steps to each other. Bots can work with files in their own folder, run commands, use skills including MCP and browse in their own browser, but they stop and wait for your approval before submitting or paying for anything. Scheduled daily or weekly jobs keep running from the menu bar. Chats, memory, files and logins stay local. Available for Mac (Apple silicon) now, with Windows and Linux coming soon.
- [Motion Transfer](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/motion-transfer.html) (added 2026-10-22): Motion Transfer animates a character photo by copying the movement from a reference video: the photo sets the look while the clip drives gestures, expressions and body motion. Upload your own 4-30 second clip or pick a ready-made motion template, choose the model, resolution, length and aspect ratio in settings, see a credit estimate first, then preview and download the result. It also includes general AI image and video generation from one shared credit balance.
- [Reference to Video](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/reference-to-video.html) (added 2026-10-22): Reference to Video turns product photos into 6-second AI ad clips for ecommerce and social: upload a product image, pick a shot style (showcase, lifestyle UGC, close-up detail or slow camera move) and an aspect ratio, and get a vertical, landscape or square video in 480p or 720p. Its reference mode treats the photo as a strict guide for tighter product fidelity and camera control.
- [FloGPT](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/flogpt.html) (added 2026-10-22): FloGPT is an AI chat and voice agent platform with a built-in AI CRM: embed a chat widget on your website, run AI phone agents around the clock, and handle chat, voice, email, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook conversations from one inbox, all grounded in your own knowledge base.
- [Kestra](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kestra.html) (added 2026-10-22): Kestra is an open-source, event-driven orchestration and scheduling platform where workflows are declared in YAML or built in a no-code editor. It includes an AI Agent task that gives flows an LLM with memory and tools, supports nested agents and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, and can expose any flow as a tool to external AI agents through its MCP server. It runs in the cloud, on-prem or air-gapped and is Apache 2.0 licensed.
- [Windmill](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/windmill.html) (added 2026-10-22): Windmill is an open-source developer platform that turns scripts in Python, TypeScript, Go, SQL and other languages into webhooks, workflows and internal UIs. Its flows include AI agent steps that call an LLM with your scripts as tools, support nested agents and MCP, and run on a fast self-hostable workflow engine. It positions itself as an open-source alternative to Retool and Temporal.
- [Inngest](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/inngest.html) (added 2026-10-22): Inngest is a durable workflow orchestration platform for running stateful step functions and AI workflows on serverless, servers or the edge. You write functions in TypeScript, Python or Go with automatic retries, queues, throttling and human-in-the-loop waits, and its AgentKit and AI inference steps let you build durable, long-running AI agents with tracing and evals. The server is source-available (SSPL, converting to Apache 2.0 later) and can be self-hosted, or you can use Inngest Cloud.
- [Cayu](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cayu.html) (added 2026-10-22): Cayu is an open-source Python framework for building and running domain-specific, long-horizon agents on a durable runtime. Sessions survive restarts and redeploys from SQLite or Postgres stores, tool policies can require human approval before side effects, spend caps are checked before each model call, and timers, background tasks, subagents and forks cover longer multi-agent work. It is Apache 2.0 licensed.
- [Diagrid Catalyst MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/diagrid-catalyst-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-22): The Diagrid Catalyst MCP server lets AI coding agents build and operate Dapr Workflows and Dapr durable agents on Diagrid Catalyst, the managed platform for long-running, fault-tolerant agent and workflow apps. Through it an agent can create and inspect workflows, check running instances and manage Catalyst resources from your MCP client. It is the official server from Diagrid, the company behind Dapr, and needs a Catalyst sign-in.
- [FableCut](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fablecut.html) (added 2026-10-22): FableCut is a Premiere-style video editor that runs entirely in the browser and exposes the whole timeline as one JSON document, covering media, clips, tracks, effects, keyframes and transitions. You can edit by hand or let an AI agent such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop cut the video over MCP or REST while the timeline updates live. It has no npm dependencies, starts with one node command and is MIT licensed.
- [Foreman](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/foreman.html) (added 2026-10-22): Foreman from ThruWire supervises coding agents with fast decision models. You give it a ticket, spec or bug report and it runs Codex, OpenCode, Hermes or LangChain's Deep Agents Code as workers, or attaches to supported sessions such as Pi, then independently judges whether the job meets the original requirements, whether the test evidence is enough and when verification or human input is needed. Extra checks can be configured for your workflow, and it is MIT licensed.
- [Wisp Science](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/wisp-science.html) (added 2026-10-22): Wisp Science is an open-source, local-first AI research workbench for scientists on Windows, macOS and Linux. Its agent searches the literature, runs persistent Python and R kernels on your laptop or remote servers, queries about 80 scientific databases and loads reusable skills, while keeping figures, runs, decisions and drafts together in one project. You bring your own OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic model, or drive Codex or Claude Code, and approval gates stay on by default.
- [OpenHarness](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openharness.html) (added 2026-10-22): OpenHarness from Autonomous is a native command center for running coding agents side by side, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Devin, Amp and Copilot. It links your laptop, home server and GPU box into one window with a password instead of SSH keys or port forwarding, keeps code and keystrokes end-to-end encrypted through its relay, and is keyboard first. Agents keep working when you close it, and it extends beyond code to CAD, circuits, robots, games and music.
- [AOCI-CODE](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/aoci-code.html) (added 2026-10-22): AOCI-CODE keeps a persistent, Git-versioned map of your whole codebase and database schema that your coding agent writes and a local MCP server governs. Agents in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor or OpenCode read the map once and know what each file is for, what it depends on and what must not break, instead of re-reading the repo on every task. It can index an existing codebase of up to about half a million lines and report how well it knows each area before taking over development.
- [MemoraX Code](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/memorax-code.html) (added 2026-10-22): MemoraX Code is a shared memory layer for coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Trae and DeepSeek Harness. It recalls prior engineering knowledge, captures lessons from finished work, keeps repository knowledge and architecture history up to date, and carries your procedures and preferences into new sessions, bringing back only the memory relevant to the task at hand. It needs Node.js 20 or later and is MIT licensed.
- [Unreal Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/unreal-agent.html) (added 2026-10-22): Unreal Agent is an async-first agent harness from Unreal Labs, a team researching how to make agentic workflows efficient. The library handles inputs with stable IDs and deduplication, append-only sessions that can be forked, and a coordinator that manages each model turn and translates tool calls into operations. It ships with a cloud agent runner, a terminal UI and benchmark runners, under the MIT license.
- [OmniRush](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/omnirush.html) (added 2026-10-22): OmniRush is a desktop coding agent for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a terminal CLI as well. It works through the files of your own projects, reading code, making edits and running commands, and gives free access to frontier models from a model picker, with GPT 6 Astra as the default. Builds for each platform are published on its releases page.
- [Mercury 3](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mercury-3.html) (added 2026-10-22): Mercury 3 is Inception's diffusion language model, which writes many tokens in parallel rather than one at a time, reaching over 1,000 tokens per second on NVIDIA GPUs with a 1M-token context, tool calling and structured outputs. It has an OpenAI-compatible API and is also offered on OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel, which makes it a fit for voice bots, support agents and browser agents where response speed matters. Pricing is per million input and output tokens.
- [Voxtral 3](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/voxtral-3.html) (added 2026-10-22): Voxtral 3 is Mistral AI's voice agent stack: speech-to-text in 50+ languages with speaker labels and end-of-turn detection, expressive text-to-speech in 35+ languages, and a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit that handles listening, tool calls and speaking in one stream over SIP or WebRTC. You can use it through Mistral's API with EU, US or global endpoints, or deploy it yourself, and it is priced per minute of audio or per character.
- [UseIt Studio](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/useit-studio.html) (added 2026-10-22): UseIt Studio is an AI design agent for things you can hold. You describe what you want in a sentence, it asks the questions a designer would, and you refine any detail by pointing at it. Instead of a flat mockup you get a real, editable design file ready to print, cut and fold, with true dimensions, bleed and dielines, for pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, packaging and brand kits. It runs in the browser, and a Windows desktop helper lets you call it up anywhere.
- [BAND](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/band.html) (added 2026-10-22): BAND is an interaction layer for teams running many AI agents alongside people. Agents and humans share one chat-like workspace where they coordinate tasks, exchange context and hand off work in real time, with governance over how agents communicate built in, instead of hand-wiring every handoff. BAND for Developers connects coding agents across your existing development tools so they can work together without you acting as their project manager.
- [Needle](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/needle.html) (added 2026-10-22): Needle is an outbound engine built for AI agents to drive. You connect it to Claude, ChatGPT or Grok and describe who you want to reach in one prompt; it finds leads from LinkedIn, Instagram and Google Maps, enriches them with context for personal messages, and reaches out from your own connected accounts on whichever channel the lead uses, with sending limits built in. It works for sales, partnerships, hiring or fundraising outreach, and you can start for free.
- [PhoneUse](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/phoneuse.html) (added 2026-10-22): PhoneUse gives AI agents phones of their own to operate. Agents get cloud Android phones that boot in seconds and scale to hundreds, or real retail iPhones and Androids in a San Francisco rack, tapped by a robot stylus, for apps that detect emulators, with real carrier numbers for SMS and 2FA codes. One MCP server with tools such as acquire, read screen, tap, type, swipe, open app and read SMS plugs into Claude, Cursor, Codex or Windsurf, and there is a Python SDK and REST API. On-demand cloud phones are billed per minute, with flat monthly prices for dedicated and real phones.
- [1Password for Agents](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/1password-for-agents.html) (added 2026-10-22): 1Password for Agents lets personal AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords or one-time codes. When a supported agent reaches a sign-in page, it asks for a credential from your vault; you approve the request, and 1Password fills it straight into the site, so the secret never enters the model or its memory. You can see and manage which agents have access to what. It launched with integrations for agents such as Claude Duet, ChatGPT Work and dots, Meta's Muse and Grok Bot, and needs a 1Password plan.
- [Claude Duet](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/claude-duet.html) (added 2026-10-22): Claude Duet is Anthropic's proactive personal agent app, in research preview. You message it like an assistant: it sends a morning brief from your connected apps, keeps watch on your inbox, calendar and follow-ups through the day, and only pings you when something needs you. You can also hand it tasks, from scheduling meetings to building dashboards or simple web apps, and it keeps working when you step away but checks with you before acting on your behalf. It runs on iOS, Android and claude.ai, starting with a waitlist for US Pro and Max subscribers on their existing plan limits.
- [superagnt](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/superagnt.html) (added 2026-10-22): superagnt is a hosted MCP server and REST API that gives AI agents one key for the tools they lack: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit and X data, web scraping to clean markdown or JSON, email finding and lead enrichment, plus a real Postgres database, memory, schedules, queues and an inbox. Credits are charged only on successful calls, and it plugs into Claude, Cursor, Codex and other agents.
